name: The Joule Dallas
positioning: The Joule: a revitalized neo-Gothic landmark in downtown Dallas with a cantilevered rooftop pool, a subterranean spa and art on display from the lobby
best_for: Art lovers who want a downtown Dallas base
Travelers who want restaurants, a cocktail bar and a spa in the same building

facts.text: The Joule is a revitalized neo-Gothic landmark in the center of downtown Dallas.
The hotel is at 1530 Main St. in downtown Dallas.
All rooms include a mini bar, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 400-thread-count Kassatex linens, Salt & Stone amenities, a rainfall shower and down pillows and comforter.
The Loft Suite is a two-story suite with 20-foot ceilings.
The Joule Penthouse has a pool table, a private library, a kitchenette and two terraces.
CBD Provisions is a brasserie that is French in method and Texan in manner, with dishes that celebrate local ingredients.
Sassetta is an Italian destination restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner daily, with brunch on weekends.
Sassetta's popular dishes include lobster spaghetti and burnt honey pizza.
Weekend Coffee in the lobby uses beans from Counter Culture.
The Mosaic Bar is a lobby bar for a first drink of the night or a nightcap.
Spa treatments include custom facials, holistic body rituals and restorative massages.
The 9th-floor Fitness Center has Technogym aerobic and strength-training equipment, free weights, wellness balls and yoga mats.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool is cantilevered, giving swimmers the sensation of swimming out beyond the hotel's edge.
Midnight Rambler is a subterranean cocktail bar reached down a flight of stairs.
The Spa at The Joule is a subterranean spa with a holistic approach to wellness.
Works by artists including Tony Tasset, Andy Warhol and Millard Sheets are on display, starting in the lobby.
A giant 30-foot eyeball sculpture stands across the street from the hotel.

considerations.text: To use the spa's European heat experiences, plan to arrive about an hour before your treatment.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional hotel tranquility.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
